failure_modes.recovery: Reject the expense first (admin+) if it must leave the books — approval-trail rows are never deleted.
failure_modes.when: the expense is pending, approved or reimbursed (approval_locked: true)

preconditions: id is required. Only draft and rejected expenses can be deleted.

description: Deletes an expense you created — draft and rejected rows only. Pending, approved, and reimbursed rows are approval-trail records and refuse with CONFLICT (approval_locked: true), and the lock is pinned into the delete itself so a status change racing your read still refuses instead of silently deleting. NEXT: expense_reject it first (admin+) if it must leave the books.
name: expense_delete
